posts.title: Untangling Microsoft Graph's $batch requests in Burp
posts.description: tl;dr: Requests to Microsoft Graph’s $batch endpoint bundle several API calls into one JSON object. This makes analyzing Azure Portal traffic difficult, since underlying API calls for requests to the $batch endpoint are not individually logged.
